resolutions.explanation: Retain the existing iṣṭa-aviśiṣṭa-mati reading: even those whose minds are not distinguished by sacrificial worship. Iṣṭa as sacrifice is independently attested, aviśiṣṭa negates distinguished, and matayaḥ supplies minds/understanding in a possessive plural. The scalar api and ease of attaining heaven through the compassionate glance support the existing concessive construction. This closes an editorial choice without claiming that all other traditional segmentations are impossible. No rewrite merely to match another translator.
